name: Write stories about character physical transformations
description: Users asked for creative fiction stories centering on characters undergoing physical or magical transformations, including changes to gender, body type, species, or permanent encasement in armor or suits. The narratives often focused on detailed descriptions of the physiological changes and the characters' emotional reactions, such as euphoria, acceptance, or confusion, alongside themes of disguise and identity.
